narrationTexts: Now applying the migration to each file (all straightforward positional-to-object conversions; `cache.query` calls are unrelated and left untouched).
Confirming no `db.query` remains outside the vendored file.
finalText:
**Migration done.** 12 files moved from `db.query` to `db.execute`.

Updated: `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `sla.js`, `session.js`, `refund.js`, `returnService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says it's overwritten on every vendor upgrade, so local edits would be lost.

Next: nothing.
